settings.name: USE_CORS
settings.description: **Enable CORS:** Set to `yes` to enable Cross-Origin Resource Sharing.

settings.name: CORS_ALLOW_ORIGIN
settings.description: **Allowed Origins:** PCRE regular expression representing allowed origins; use `*` for any origin, or `self` for same-origin only.

settings.name: CORS_ALLOW_METHODS
settings.description: **Allowed Methods:** HTTP methods that can be used in cross-origin requests.

settings.name: CORS_ALLOW_HEADERS
settings.description: **Allowed Headers:** HTTP headers that can be used in cross-origin requests.

settings.name: CORS_ALLOW_CREDENTIALS
settings.description: **Allow Credentials:** Set to `yes` to allow credentials (cookies, HTTP authentication) in CORS requests.

settings.name: CORS_EXPOSE_HEADERS
settings.description: **Exposed Headers:** HTTP headers that browsers are permitted to access from cross-origin responses.

settings.name: CROSS_ORIGIN_OPENER_POLICY
settings.description: **Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy:** Controls communication between browsing contexts. Allowed values: `unsafe-none`, `same-origin-allow-popups`, `same-origin`; leave empty to omit this header.

settings.name: CROSS_ORIGIN_EMBEDDER_POLICY
settings.description: **Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy:** Controls whether a document can load resources from other origins. Allowed values: `unsafe-none`, `require-corp`, `credentialless`; leave empty to omit this header.

settings.name: CROSS_ORIGIN_RESOURCE_POLICY
settings.description: **Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy:** Controls which websites can embed your resources. Allowed values: `same-site`, `same-origin`, `cross-origin`; leave empty to omit this header.

settings.name: CORS_MAX_AGE
settings.description: **Preflight Cache Duration:** How long (in seconds) browsers should cache the preflight response. Accepts a time suffix (ms, s, m, h, d, w, M, y); a bare number is seconds.

settings.name: CORS_DENY_REQUEST
settings.description: **Deny Unauthorized Origins:** When `yes`, requests from unauthorized origins are denied with an error code.
